title: Beyond the 956: Lance Broadway, former MLB pitcher and 'Olympus Has Fallen' actor, dies at 43
excerpt: Lance Broadway, the former major league pitcher who became an actor after his baseball career, died Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in Dallas. He was 43. The Associated Press confirmed his death.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Lance Broadway, the former major league pitcher who became an actor following his baseball career, has died at 43.

Broadway died on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in a stairwell at an apartment complex near Love Field Airport in Dallas, according to a report from the Dallas County Medical Examiner's Office. The Associated Press confirmed his death. His cause of death was not immediately clear, and the manner of death is pending.

Born Lance Daniel Broadway on August 20, 1983, in Bryan, Texas, he pitched in college at Dallas Baptist University and Texas Christian University. He was taken in the first round of the 2005 draft by the Chicago White Sox and appeared in 27 major league games for the White Sox and the New York Mets from 2007 to 2009.

After baseball, Broadway turned to acting. He made his movie debut in 2013's Olympus Has Fallen, playing Secret Service Agent O'Neil alongside Gerard Butler, and appeared in Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. in 2016. His television credits also included Lucifer, Colony and Real Husbands of Hollywood.

Sources: The Associated Press; The Hollywood Reporter; Page Six.
